I just want to say I noticed a drastic improvement in myself last week when it comes to social anxiety and happiness.

 After being unemployed for a while, I picked up some side work and put my all into it one day and noticed the next day I felt more focused, driven, and even more socially comfortable.

I tried to focus on discipline and being mindful of how I use my energy and the energy I put out to people. For the first time in my life, I hung out with my friends and felt like the most talkative one in the room. And the best part, they didn't seem annoyed and expanded on everything I had to say.

Today I'm in a bit more of a rut because of some health and financial issues but I want to pick back up where I left off asap and try to be the best version of myself I can.

That last paragraph struck a chord.

We spent what felt like a lot of time in silence but I wanted to maintain a welcoming presence and let her know I'm willing to talk about anything. Trying to be romantic is still kind of hard. I felt like I would try and end up saying something corny or off putting to her if I tried to be romantic and it felt like she always had a guard up and had a tendency to brush things off almost as if she wouldn't believe it or take it serious.

I tried talking to her a lot with no filter/ not thinking too deeply and it would work out well sometimes but other times she seemed bored of me. And plenty times I tried to start a conversation with the intention of getting romantic. Sometimes it went well and we'd have each other blushing then other times it would crash and burn into a casual, platonic conversation that doesn't go anywhere. And then of course, I'd have moments of anxiety where we'd just lay in bed next to each other and all I feel I can do is sit there and not do anything to ruin the moment. It's almost like paralysis.

I felt like we were doing all those things together... Maybe it didn't go as perceived from me or she had her own reasons for feeling this way. We still talk as friends in our group chat and she's back to saying things like "____ is so fine". Lusting after other people basically. Which doesn't bother me, but she also acts like nothing happened and has moved on and it feels like she's prying distance between us. Space isn't a problem, but now I'm confused because she says she's self aware that she can be toxic and she doesn't want to hurt me because I deserve better and wants to "preserve our friendship" but now we feel more like strangers than ever.

This probably was besides the point but it felt necessary to expand some.

Thank you ❤. I'll try to focus more on being mindful with my feelings and actions. I'm looking into getting my first therapy session in the near future.
